The '''Warbird starfighter''' was a custom [[starfighter]] model utilized by the [[Warbird gang]] during the [[First Order-Resistance War]]. The starfighter was heavily modified, taking parts from [[A-wing starfighter|A-wings]], [[Eta-2 Actis-class light interceptor|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptors]], and [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] [[TIE/IN interceptor]]s.<ref name="Ult" />
